style: cinematic 3D, Pixar-quality, dusty vest, hard hat, matte, deadpan slapstick
shot: vertical 9:16, camera always moving, shot size changing wide to macro; pushes in on 2.1, 4.15, 7.6, wide on 9.0
character: PIGLET FOREMAN: businesslike pig, dignity to the last; back curves only in final beat; same design throughout
cast: BULL BANK COLLECTOR: large bull, necktie, stamp in his free hand; close to lens from entrance; never speaks
props: form: ОДОБРЕНО stamp from hook, 2nd stamp at beat 7. brick: price tag, from wheelbarrow, rotated, set by ready row, thrown back in. trowel: from tool belt at drop-thud. wheelbarrow: in at beat 5, off at beat 9. ready row, gravel, bucket present from 0.0. No on-screen text but stamp marks.
setting: bright sunny morning, open construction site; brick row by a poured foundation; gravel pile, overturned bucket
lighting: bright morning sun, fully lit daylight

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: male, low warm chest voice ~130Hz, dry, businesslike deadpan, native Russian, no accent, @Voice: Sadachbia
audio.lip_sync: piglet talks like a person, snout/jaw open-close each syllable, own voice, never a voice over

timeline.a: Hook: the stamp swings past the lens on its cord and blacks out the frame; behind it he staggers, hard hat clacking
dry, deadpan; he walks at the lens uncoiling from the crouch until his chest fills the frame, the form shaking in his trotters
no gap; the climb reaches full stretch, spine snaps straight, and the form flies up across the whole frame
Drops hard onto all four trotters, thud kicks up dust, form slaps flat; snatches the trowel from tool belt in the same motion, slaps mortar on the foundation
Wheelbarrow crashes in, bull brakes hard, shoves his shoulder, muzzle huge at lens; flips the board, piglet grabs the tagged brick, starts lifting it
flat disbelief; the brick swings a full turn edge to edge across the frame, held right at the lens
the brick fills the frame at the lens, then drops away to reveal the bull slamming his stamp onto the form
Piglet sets the brick beside the ready row, flush; bull grabs it, hurls it into the wheelbarrow
Bull kicks the wheelbarrow rolling off behind him without stepping back, staying close to the lens; wheel clips the gravel, spraying grit on the piglet; he snaps the trowel up
flat and dry, eyes on the lens; trowel lowers slowly
timeline.camera: only push-in begins here, tightening to end

timeline.a: Trowel settles in silence; sits on the bucket, back curving first time, tracing its rim

must_appear: a wordless tick-in-circle pictogram on the stamp, never letters; the stamp crossing the lens at 0.0; the brick filling the frame at 5.15; the bull huge at the lens from 3.2
negative_prompt: night, dusk, lamp, dim, moody, low-key, dark scene; locked-off camera, static shot; bricks stacking, floating objects; duplicated brick, form, trowel, wheelbarrow or stamp; stamp leaving his hand; second piglet or bull, crowd, human hands; cuts; extra limbs; easing or slowing before the crack-pop, stillness during the rise; slow speech, English speech, foreign accent; subtitles, watermark, text overlay, any lettering or Cyrillic in frame, readable words on the stamp
motion_rule: EVERY second something large crosses or fills the frame: the piglet, the form, the brick, the bull, the wheelbarrow or the camera; never a second where only the mouth moves
lens_passes: something sweeps right past the lens at 0.0, 2.1, 3.2, 6.15, 9.0
